sources.title: Prescott et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign adult guideline (2026)
sources.scope: Adult infection/source-control and individualized hemodynamic assessment. Not a postcardiotomy diagnosis. Publisher correction exists: 10.1007/s00134-026-08410-9; no precise disputed table value is used here.
sources.checked: Publisher guideline passages and PubMed identity; correction identity noted, full correction text not retrieved

sources.title: Qadir et al. ATS ARDS update (2024)
sources.scope: Conditional options depend on severity and patient selection; a P:F ratio is not a standalone escalation command.

sources.title: Hall et al. Management of Post-cardiotomy Shock (2024)
sources.scope: Review of mixed shock after cardiac surgery. Not a universal drug or lactate threshold.
sources.checked: PubMed abstract and available PMC passages

sources.title: ESC Acute cor pulmonale consensus (2024)
sources.scope: RV afterload/preload/contractility assessment; surgical and device populations need additional sources.
sources.checked: Publisher consensus identity and available passages

sources.title: Lorusso et al. ELSO adult VA-ECMO interim guideline (2021)
sources.scope: Specialist circulatory-support assessment; not a cannulation or adjustment manual.

sources.title: Tonna et al. ELSO adult VV-ECMO guideline (2021)
sources.scope: Respiratory-support/circuit interpretation; differs from VA physiology.

sources.title: Saeed et al. ISHLT mechanical circulatory support update (2023)
sources.scope: Device-specific assessment and specialist oversight; displayed flow alone does not establish cause.
sources.checked: Society guideline and PubMed identity/selected text

sources.title: Isselbacher et al. ACC/AHA aortic disease guideline (2022)
sources.scope: Aortic/perfusion assessment; no universal postoperative BP prescription supplied.
sources.checked: AHA/PubMed DOI identity and available PMC guideline text

sources.title: Otto et al. ACC/AHA valvular heart disease guideline (2020, journal publication 2021)
sources.scope: Prosthesis and patient context matter for anticoagulation; not a universal INR rule.
sources.checked: PubMed identity; corrections listed in record, exact targets not reproduced

sources.title: Snell et al. ISHLT PGD definition/grading, 2016 consensus published 2017
sources.scope: Timing, imaging and gas-exchange context required; definition source is not a complete treatment guideline.
sources.checked: PubMed identity and available published definition context

sources.title: STARRT-AKI investigators. Timing of Initiation of Renal-Replacement Therapy (2020)
sources.scope: Timing trial in selected severe AKI; urgent indications are a separate clinical question.
sources.checked: Primary trial record and available abstract

sources.title: de-Madaria et al. WATERFALL trial (2022)
sources.scope: Aggressive fluids increased overload in the studied population; not a fixed replacement strategy for established postoperative organ failure.

sources.title: Carney et al. Severe TBI guideline, fourth edition (2017)
sources.scope: Severe-injury-specific neurocritical assessment; no automatic sedation or osmotic-therapy prescription here.
sources.checked: Brain Trauma Foundation executive summary and publisher recommendations

sources.title: Hoh et al. AHA/ASA aneurysmal SAH guideline (2023)
sources.scope: Separate delayed ischemia assessment from prophylactic augmentation.
sources.checked: PubMed and AHA guideline record/available passages

sources.title: Lewis et al. PADIS focused update (2025)
sources.scope: Pain/anxiety/sedation/delirium questions in adult ICU; not every earlier PADIS topic is replaced.

sources.title: Rochwerg et al. ERS/ATS NIV guideline (2017)
sources.scope: NIV suitability and goals differ by etiology and treatment preferences.

sources.title: Kirkpatrick et al. WSACS definitions/guideline (2013)
sources.scope: Pressure interpreted with organ dysfunction and context; not a dressing-change instruction.

sources.title: ESICM end-of-life/palliative care guideline (2024)
sources.scope: Patient priorities, communication and symptom reassessment; jurisdiction and culture matter.
sources.checked: Society/publisher guideline record and available passages

sources.title: ICMR DNAR consensus (2020)
sources.scope: DNAR pertains to resuscitation rather than a blanket limit on all treatment; Indian guidance used as ethical context, not US legal authority.

cases.title: Postoperative hemodynamic instability
cases.vignette: A fictional postoperative adult develops hypotension, rising lactate and chest-drain output. Cardiac function and the bleeding source have not been established.
cases.female_extra: Prior ventricular dysfunction is documented.
cases.application: Separate blood loss, pump failure, obstruction and vascular tone; focused imaging and serial perfusion findings discriminate the branches.
cases.medication_context: Vasoactive support does not correct a surgical bleeding source; analgesic/sedative effects also belong in the medication review.

cases.title: DNI status and respiratory distress
cases.vignette: An older fictional adult with COPD and pneumonia is distressed and has difficulty tolerating non-invasive ventilation. DNR/DNI is documented; other treatment preferences are unknown.
cases.male_extra: Wants active treatment short of intubation.
cases.female_extra: Preferences beyond DNI have not been discussed.
cases.application: Clarify the treatment ceiling and trial goals before interpreting NIV intolerance; distinguish reversible distress from a separately chosen symptom-only plan.
cases.medication_context: Analgesia and anxiolysis require respiratory reassessment; a sedative combination is not implied by DNI.

cases.title: Worsening septic shock
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with suspected infection has increasing vasopressor requirements, mottling, oliguria and rising lactate.
cases.male_extra: Source is suspected but not controlled.
cases.female_extra: Positive fluid balance and congestion are present.
cases.application: Reassess infection/source control and perfusion while asking whether additional fluid is both effective and tolerated.
cases.medication_context: Antimicrobials and vasopressor support are distinct interventions; culture/resistance and organ function inform drug discussions.

cases.title: Rib fractures and impaired ventilation
cases.vignette: A fictional trauma patient has chest-wall pain, shallow breathing and increasing oxygen needs. Associated injuries are incompletely described.
cases.female_extra: Sleep apnea and other injuries need clarification.
cases.application: Evaluate chest injury, ventilation and analgesic adequacy together; a pain score alone cannot exclude worsening respiratory injury.
cases.medication_context: Local/regional or systemic analgesia are discussion options after injury and bleeding-risk assessment; respiratory effects matter.

cases.title: Myocarditis and shock
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with suspected fulminant myocarditis has poor perfusion despite initial support. Ventricular function, rhythm and the cause of inflammation need reassessment.
cases.female_extra: Biventricular dysfunction is suspected.
cases.application: Characterize rhythm and ventricular involvement before comparing pharmacologic support with expert mechanical-support assessment.
cases.medication_context: Inotrope, vasopressor and sedation choices depend on the assessed physiology; suspected myocarditis does not select an empiric immune-treatment regimen.

cases.title: Pancreatitis with respiratory and renal dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional postoperative adult with pancreatitis has pain, positive fluid balance, worsening breathing and rising creatinine.
cases.male_extra: Recent fluids were followed by dyspnea.
cases.female_extra: Baseline kidney dysfunction complicates fluid tolerance.
cases.application: The WATERFALL result argues against assuming more fluid is better; established organ failure differs from its trial population and requires individualized reassessment.
cases.medication_context: Analgesic choice and renal/hepatic exposure need review; no fixed high-volume fluid or drug infusion follows from the diagnosis.

cases.title: Brain injury with aspiration and airway decline
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with traumatic brain injury develops reduced alertness and suspected aspiration.
cases.female_extra: Recent sedatives confound the examination.
cases.application: Separate airway/oxygenation threats, injury progression and medication effects; a sedative-adjusted examination is not equivalent to exclusion of intracranial deterioration.
cases.medication_context: Hypnotics, analgesics and osmotic agents have different purposes; no dose or ventilation target can be selected from the abbreviated case.

cases.title: Sepsis with ARDS and kidney injury
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with pneumonia has bilateral opacities, impaired gas exchange, positive fluid balance and kidney dysfunction.
cases.female_extra: Fluid accumulation accompanies kidney injury.
cases.application: Integrate lung-protection assessment, infection/source control and fluid tolerance rather than treating isolated oxygenation or creatinine values.
cases.medication_context: Sedation or neuromuscular-block discussions depend on the actual ventilation problem; renal support is a separate indication-based decision.

cases.title: Shock immediately after CABG
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after coronary bypass has hypotension, low estimated output, hypothermia and ongoing drain output.
cases.female_extra: Echo suggests reduced contractility.
cases.application: Use surgical assessment and verified output measurements to distinguish blood loss from pump failure, while allowing coexistence.
cases.medication_context: A vasopressor, inotrope or transfusion discussion addresses different mechanisms; none is selected solely by MAP.

cases.title: VA-ECMO after myocardial infarction
cases.vignette: A fictional adult on VA-ECMO has improving lactate but oliguria and concern about limb perfusion.
cases.female_extra: Urine output is low despite falling lactate.
cases.application: Falling lactate does not settle limb perfusion or kidney questions; evaluate each organ and circuit configuration.
cases.medication_context: Anticoagulation, vasoactive and analgesic choices require bleeding/perfusion context and specialist oversight.

cases.title: Early LVAD and RV function
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after LVAD implantation has changing displayed flow and pulsatility with borderline RV function.
cases.female_extra: Displayed flow varies with rhythm.
cases.application: Interpret loading, rhythm, ventricular interaction and device data together before assigning a device cause.
cases.medication_context: Fluid and vasoactive changes are not substitutes for device assessment; no universal speed or dose follows from a display value.

cases.title: Pneumonia-associated ARDS
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with ARDS has a reported P:F ratio near 87, increased driving pressure and vasopressor support.
cases.male_extra: P:F is 87 with stable sampling conditions.
cases.female_extra: A similar ratio was measured under different support.
cases.application: Check comparability and mechanics before grading severity; assess lung protection and hemodynamic tolerance before discussing conditional adjuncts.
cases.medication_context: Corticosteroids or neuromuscular blockade are indication-dependent options in the cited guideline, not automatic responses to a ratio.

cases.title: Aortic repair, hypertension and AKI
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after type A dissection repair develops hypertension, oliguria and rising creatinine.
cases.female_extra: New perfusion asymmetry is noted.
cases.application: Assess anatomy and organ perfusion as well as pressure; distinguish possible malperfusion from congestion or medication-related kidney changes.
cases.medication_context: Rate/pressure-control discussion is specific to repair and perfusion; repeated fluid or antihypertensive changes are not an imaging substitute.

cases.title: Lung transplantation and graft dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional lung-transplant recipient develops poor compliance, impaired gas exchange and fluid accumulation.
cases.male_extra: Abnormal imaging appears early after transplant.
cases.female_extra: Cardiac congestion is a competing explanation.
cases.application: Check transplant timing, imaging and competing causes before using PGD classification; donor/recipient size and mechanics need context.
cases.medication_context: Diuresis, ventilator support and immune therapy answer different questions; none is established by poor compliance alone.

cases.title: Sepsis and an open abdomen
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with abdominal sepsis has worsening shock, oliguria and positive fluid balance.
cases.female_extra: Pressure is elevated with new kidney dysfunction.
cases.application: Review source control and measured pressure with new organ dysfunction; isolated pressure is not the whole syndrome.
cases.medication_context: Antimicrobial and hemodynamic treatment require reassessment; no dressing manipulation or fixed fluid-removal rate is implied.

cases.title: SAH with stress cardiomyopathy
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after aneurysm treatment has cardiac dysfunction and concern about cerebral perfusion.
cases.male_extra: Neurologic concern occurs with reduced LV function.
cases.female_extra: Hemodynamic support may worsen pulmonary congestion.
cases.application: Check cerebral perfusion measurements and whether symptomatic delayed ischemia is present before discussing competing circulatory goals.
cases.medication_context: Nimodipine and hemodynamic augmentation have different indications; prophylactic hypertension or a fixed sodium regimen is not inferred.

cases.title: CABG with vasoplegia, hypothermia and bleeding
cases.vignette: A fictional bypass recipient has hypotension, a rising lactate trend, reduced calculated vascular resistance and drain output.
cases.female_extra: Low calculated resistance coexists with low output.
cases.application: Check how resistance was calculated and whether bleeding, pump dysfunction and tone abnormalities overlap.
cases.medication_context: Vasopressors do not replace correction of an anatomic or bleeding cause; do not infer vasodilation from low temperature alone.

cases.title: VA-ECMO with rising lactate
cases.vignette: A fictional myocarditis patient on VA-ECMO has rising lactate and concern about hemolysis, LV distension or circuit dysfunction.
cases.male_extra: Lactate rises while LV opening is uncertain.
cases.female_extra: Hemolysis markers rise with circuit concern.
cases.application: Evaluate LV loading, blood trauma and circuit performance separately; apparent circuit flow does not establish effective tissue delivery.
cases.medication_context: An escalation in vasoactive drugs or circuit flow is not a universal response; the ECMO team evaluates competing effects.

cases.title: LVAD with RV dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional LVAD recipient has rising venous pressure, falling pulsatility and worsening renal function.
cases.male_extra: Venous pressure rises with kidney dysfunction.
cases.female_extra: Rhythm changes accompany reduced pulsatility.
cases.application: Compare RV, rhythm and loading explanations using imaging and device context; a congestion label does not prove fluid responsiveness.
cases.medication_context: Fluid, diuretic and inotrope discussions require different supporting findings and device-team review.

cases.title: ARDS after supination
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with ARDS has worsening oxygenation and carbon dioxide retention after supination.
cases.female_extra: Airway secretions are a competing cause.
cases.application: Recheck airway mechanics, comparable gases and positional effects before attributing deterioration to loss of recruitment alone.
cases.medication_context: A mode switch, paralytic or sedative is not guaranteed to reduce lung stress; ECMO assessment is a separate specialist question.

cases.title: Aortic repair with new pain and oliguria
cases.vignette: A fictional aortic-surgery patient has new back pain, hypertension and deteriorating urine output.
cases.female_extra: New leg symptoms accompany hypertension.
cases.application: New symptoms after repair require urgent anatomic/perfusion reassessment; a filling-pressure target cannot rule out malperfusion.
cases.medication_context: Analgesia may be needed but should not become a substitute for evaluation of the underlying complication.

cases.title: Early lung-graft dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional transplant recipient has low compliance and worsening gas exchange soon after surgery.
cases.male_extra: Gas exchange worsens soon after graft implantation.
cases.female_extra: Imaging and cardiac findings are incomplete.
cases.application: Organize the differential before labeling PGD; ventilation measurements do not independently establish recruitability.
cases.medication_context: No PEEP change, immune regimen or ECMO threshold is derived from the limited data.

cases.title: Abdominal sepsis with refractory shock
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after bowel surgery remains shocked with oliguria and venous congestion.
cases.female_extra: Congestion persists after abdominal surgery.
cases.application: Assess infection control, perfusion and kidney complications separately; severe AKI alone is not an automatic accelerated-dialysis mandate.
cases.medication_context: Antimicrobials, fluid/vasoactive treatment and renal support have separate indications and exposure considerations.

cases.title: SAH with cardiac dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional aneurysmal-SAH patient has reduced cardiac function and uncertain cerebral perfusion.
cases.male_extra: CPP is reported without an ICP method.
cases.female_extra: Poor cardiac function complicates perfusion goals.
cases.application: Verify MAP/ICP measurement conditions and distinguish vasospasm from the clinical syndrome of delayed ischemia.
cases.medication_context: A preselected pressor target or sodium range is not justified by the label SAH alone.

cases.title: CABG with low vascular tone
cases.vignette: A fictional bypass recipient has hypotension, low calculated SVR, rising lactate and hypothermia.
cases.male_extra: Resistance appears low but output is uncertain.
cases.female_extra: Temperature is low with rising lactate.
cases.application: Verify the measurement and recheck tone, flow, blood loss and obstruction; a single calculated resistance cannot determine mechanism.
cases.medication_context: Methylene blue and other vasoactive agents are not routine numerical-trigger treatments; interactions and contraindications require review.

cases.title: Redo AVR with AKI and congestion
cases.vignette: A fictional valve-surgery patient has borderline cardiac output, pulmonary edema and worsening kidney function.
cases.female_extra: Venous congestion accompanies kidney dysfunction.
cases.application: Low forward flow and venous back-pressure can coexist; choose observations that distinguish mechanisms and response to prior interventions.
cases.medication_context: Inotropes and diuretics address different hypotheses; a cardiac-index cutoff alone does not select either.

cases.title: Mitral surgery, bradycardia and delirium
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after mitral surgery and MAZE has bradycardia, altered attention and respiratory support by HFNC.
cases.female_extra: Sedating medication and HFNC are documented.
cases.application: Check rhythm/perfusion and noncardiac delirium contributors; establish the actual airway device before discussing readiness tests.
cases.medication_context: Medication review may reveal rate/sedation effects; HFNC is not an endotracheal tube and does not itself call for an extubation SBT.

cases.title: Tricuspid repair and RV dysfunction
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after CABG and tricuspid repair has RV dysfunction, kidney injury and oxygen needs.
cases.female_extra: Oxygen needs change with respiratory support.
cases.application: Compare RV loading and pulmonary mechanics; both inadequate recruitment and overdistension can affect circulation.
cases.medication_context: Neither all PEEP nor all diuresis is categorically excluded; specialist assessment determines suitability.

cases.title: Mechanical AVR and anticoagulation
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after mechanical-valve surgery has a reported INR and an incompletely described bleeding risk.
cases.male_extra: Valve model and postoperative timing are known.
cases.female_extra: INR is supplied but prosthesis details are missing.
cases.application: Verify valve position/model, thrombotic context and bleeding history before interpreting the INR.
cases.medication_context: No generic warfarin hold, heparin addition or INR target is supplied; anticoagulation requires the complete clinical context.

cases.title: CABG/MVR with pulmonary edema
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after bypass and mitral surgery has reduced output, pulmonary edema, kidney injury and early fever.
cases.female_extra: Early fever accompanies otherwise similar findings.
cases.application: Assess hydrostatic, inflammatory and infectious explanations rather than treating early fever as proof of infection.
cases.medication_context: A broad antibiotic regimen or negative-fluid target cannot be selected from fever and edema alone.

cases.title: Post-MAZE bradycardia
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after MAZE has bradycardia, RV dysfunction, oliguria and altered attention.
cases.female_extra: Oliguria and inattention accompany bradycardia.
cases.application: Determine temporal association, rhythm and hemodynamic consequences; assess whether a rate change explains organ findings.
cases.medication_context: Review rate-altering and sedating drugs; atropine/pacing decisions are not made from a rate-only threshold.

cases.title: LV aneurysmectomy with low output
cases.vignette: A fictional adult after bypass and aneurysm surgery has low measured output, rising lactate and edema.
cases.male_extra: Measured output falls after aneurysm surgery.
cases.female_extra: Low venous saturation accompanies congestion.
cases.application: Confirm output and sampling, then examine mechanical/ischemic causes and the relationship of delivery to demand.
cases.medication_context: Low saturation or lactate does not independently select milrinone, transfusion or fluid removal.

cases.title: New postoperative fever
cases.vignette: A fictional valve/bypass recipient develops fever, leukocytosis and a renewed vasopressor requirement.
cases.male_extra: New fever follows a period of improvement.
cases.female_extra: Vasopressor needs rise with leukocytosis.
cases.application: Revisit infection sources and noninfectious postoperative causes; use cultures and imaging to refine hypotheses.
cases.medication_context: Antimicrobial discussion incorporates likely source, prior exposure, local resistance and organ function, not fever alone.

cases.title: RV dysfunction after tricuspid repair
cases.vignette: A fictional patient has RV dysfunction, kidney injury, congestion and HFNC support.
cases.female_extra: HFNC and changing work of breathing complicate assessment.
cases.application: Assess RV load and fluid tolerance with respiratory context rather than imposing a blanket pressure or volume rule.
cases.medication_context: No categorical beta-blocker/PEEP prohibition or extubation SBT instruction follows from these findings.

cases.title: Bentall/hemiarch with mixed shock
cases.vignette: A fictional postoperative adult has vasopressor support, biventricular dysfunction, kidney injury and an INR result.
cases.female_extra: The root prosthesis and INR indication are unclear.
cases.application: Separate pump, tone, bleeding and obstruction; identify the operation/prosthesis before discussing anticoagulation.
cases.medication_context: Vasoactive and anticoagulation choices solve different problems and require surgical-team context.

cases.title: Persistent congestion after CABG/AVR
cases.vignette: A fictional adult has persistent congestion, kidney dysfunction and incomplete response to prior diuretic treatment.
cases.female_extra: Apparent diuretic resistance accompanies low perfusion.
cases.application: Examine exposure, delivery, perfusion and urgent complications before comparing decongestion options.
cases.medication_context: More diuretic or renal support is not selected solely because balance is positive; response and tolerance matter.

cases.title: Rising lactate after CABG/mitral repair
cases.vignette: A fictional adult develops rising lactate with borderline output and pulmonary congestion.
cases.female_extra: Congestion coexists with a new rhythm change.
cases.application: Review sampling and non-flow causes of lactate, then reassess mechanical, ischemic and rhythm explanations.
cases.medication_context: A lactate cutoff alone is not an evidence-based switch to a specific inotrope.

cases.title: Early low-output physiology
cases.vignette: A fictional bypass recipient has borderline pressure, rising lactate, oliguria and RV dysfunction.
cases.male_extra: Pressure is acceptable but urine output falls.
cases.female_extra: RV dysfunction accompanies rising venous pressure.
cases.application: Assess effective perfusion and congestion together; acceptable MAP does not resolve the low-flow question.
cases.medication_context: Do not automatically withhold decongestion or lower PEEP without the broader assessment.

cases.title: Aortic repair and agitation
cases.vignette: A fictional aortic-surgery patient has agitation, intermittent hypertension and hypoxemia.
cases.female_extra: Hypoxemia and confusion accompany intermittent hypertension.
cases.application: Compare pain, respiratory and neurologic explanations before treating agitation as an isolated sedation problem.
cases.medication_context: Heart rate and pressure both matter in the aortic context; a sedative or antihypertensive is not selected by agitation alone.

cases.title: Chronic LVAD low-flow alarms
cases.vignette: A fictional LVAD patient has low-flow alarms, anemia, rising LDH and RV dysfunction.
cases.female_extra: LDH rises while RV dysfunction is documented.
cases.application: Compare device, rhythm and loading explanations; hemolysis markers do not uniquely identify thrombosis.
cases.medication_context: No empirical speed, fluid or transfusion change follows from the alarm; device-specific expert assessment is required.

cases.title: VV-ECMO with hypoxemia
cases.vignette: A fictional adult on VV-ECMO has hypoxemia, rising lactate, oliguria and high sedation requirements.
cases.male_extra: Systemic hypoxemia persists despite good post-membrane gas.
cases.female_extra: Oliguria and high sedation exposure coexist.
cases.application: Consider recirculation, native-lung disease, hemoglobin, flow and demand; one circuit gas does not settle systemic oxygen delivery.
cases.medication_context: Sweeping gas and blood flow affect different processes; no automatic paralysis, transfusion or sedative escalation is inferred.

cases.title: Explicitly chosen comfort-focused care
cases.vignette: A fictional adult with advanced illness has separately chosen a comfort-focused plan after a goals-of-care discussion.
cases.male_extra: Explicitly values alertness and relief of dyspnea.
cases.female_extra: Explicitly prioritizes relief even if some drowsiness occurs.
cases.application: Document the separately chosen comfort-focused goals and assess distress, benefit and unwanted effects over time; do not infer these goals from DNR alone.
cases.medication_context: Proportionate symptom treatment is individualized; routine sedative combinations or disease-driven targets are not substituted for the expressed priorities.
